issues.on_page: General column object lines; statement p5 General column = General government 115,817 + Public safety 38,712 + Culture and recreation 12,517 + Capital outlay 10,331
issues.issue: All General (non-Library) object lines except Contracted services and Capital outlay are tagged general government (sum 123,317), but the statement puts 115,817 in general government and 7,500 in culture and recreation (12,517 - Library 5,017). Function split is not printed by object, so this is an approximation (affects detail[6]-[8], [10]-[13]).
Mixed label 'Supplies and repairs'; could equally be Repairs and Maintenance (also detail[40], and governmental detail[12], [18], [26]).
Sales tax remitted by the utility is not a tax refund or treasurer fee; category Other Taxes Paid is fine but the detail_category is a poor fit.
Cost-type rule: this is the utility bill cost type (power/gas/phone), but the category 'utilities' is the same name as the function, so it is indistinguishable from function lines in the workbook.
